mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (monetary policy tightening) compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window for FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.5% (indicating labor market deterioration) signals economic weakness that triggers a flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5 fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The interaction of HOUST and RSAFS (both declining) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%), the Federal Reserve's policy response of raising the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) compresses equity valuations by increasing real interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.02 in high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window for PAYEMS and 20-day forward returns.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate (HOUST) above 1,400,000 units signals a robust housing market that boosts construction and consumer confidence, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1400 fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a contraction in GDP (GDPC1) signals a broad economic slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: The interaction of INDPRO and GDPC1 (both declining) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During strong retail sales periods (RSAFS > 720,000 million dollars), consumer spending growth supports corporate revenue, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where RSAFS > 720000, the 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for RSAFS and 20-day returns is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
